actual_scope: Sharp separate COPY power floor for arbitrary free one-column or one-row corrections mixed with any two P112 coordinate terms by all GL(3,C), including exactly two projected products; other six terms fixed. All28 coordinate pairs,112 singleton sites, arbitrary complex amplitudes and support subsets of the52 odd neighbors.
scope_change_reason: Select the explicit masked nine-term family left at the boundary of PR1375. Remove its support-size restriction on the nonsingleton side; include the pure-factor branch left open by PR1373. This does not repeat the eight-term all-pairs bound.
bottleneck_link: A proposed new decoder must reduce the complete COPY power bill before additional preparation, frame, restoration and hosting charges can create a gain with other contracts fixed. This family has no COPY headroom even with those extra charges set to zero.
stop_rule: Prove the all-complex GL3 floor by complete finite survivor/erasure premises and the coupled inverse-factor identity. Verify the full24-row boundary and52-row controls. Stop at the scoped obstruction; do not construct or admit a supplier.
evidence: Written proof of sum r_j^q >=2*8^q for all0<q<=1; complete COPY floor64 attained by identity mixing. Two representations check15680 even-neighbor slices,15680 singleton erasures,71540 character evaluations and700 pairings.
